messages:
kevin_oncall: Heads-up — EU privnet auditshipper is backing up and we’re seeing downstream provisioning backpressure on GPU warm pools. Queue ~12k, NATGW conntrack near limit, a few keystore 429s. Noticing pods being reshuffled across AZs and capacity dipping.

anya_security: Ouch. Is this hitting the new SIEM endpoint or the old backup path? Any indication of auth/KMS failures vs pure networking?

sara_ops: It’s flowing to SIEM over the privatelink. The handshake is fine most of the time, but bursts cause TCP resets from the NAT path -> auditshipper retries -> queue explosion. Warm-pool join requests are timing out, autoscaler moves pods -> gpu pool reshuffle.

jamal_platform: We also saw the audit sampler ramp yesterday after the keystore key rotation. Sampler +keystore throttles = more payload to the shipper. Sampler dropping ~40%, shipper retrying. Suggest short-term: route auditshipper to an S3 backup allowlist to drain while we stabilize SIEM path.

kevin_oncall: Cost tradeoff note — rerouting to S3 will spike egress/storage (~$2.5k/day at current volume) but should unblock GPU onboarding and stop autoscaler churn. Which is cheaper than sustained capacity loss.

sara_ops: Agreed. Quick mitigation steps I propose:
```yaml
- apply auditshipper allowlist -> backup-s3://redwood-audit-eu/tmp-dump
- patch sampler.rate to 0.5
- bump warm-pool target by +20% for 2h
- add ephemeral fw rule for SIEM egress (20m) while we debug
```
Jam: I can push the allowlist patch and sampler change. Will need firewall change from infra or sec to open ephemeral IPs.

deploy-bot: deploy auditshipper-allowlist v1 -> started by jamal_platform at 1742111450

anya_security: Need compliance signoff for storing temporarily in S3 (retention/TTL must be 24h, encrypt-at-rest enforced). I’ll loop in compliance. For ephemeral FW rule — will do a quick risk ack and post the rule.

jamal_platform: Plan breakdown:
1) apply allowlist -> route to S3 (started)
2) patch sampler -> reduce retries
3) scale warm-pool +20%
4) open ephemeral fw rule for SIEM egress IPs
5) monitor metrics: audit-queue, warm-pool-joins, gpu-util for 120m
I’ll post runbook updates and keep logs.

kevin_oncall: +1 for plan. I’ll coordinate on scaling and keep an eye on cost. If compliance signs off, proceed.

anya_security: Compliance acknowledged conditional signoff (S3 TTL 24h, server-side KMS, no external sharing). I’ll attach the compliance token to the allowlist PR.

sara_ops: Doing the warm-pool bump now, will watch join success. Jamal — ping when sampler patch lands and when the fw rule is up.

jamal_platform: Sampler patch applied at 1742111620. FW request filed; infra to apply.

deploy-bot: deploy auditshipper-allowlist v1 -> succeeded at 1742111705

kevin_oncall: Monitoring: queue dropped from 12k -> 900 in 20m, warm-pool join errors falling. Will keep this thread updated. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
